up: Retrieve the molecule ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, standard activity type, standard value, standard relation, and standard units for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649966. Filter the activities to only include exact measurements where standard_relation is '='. Join activities with assays on assay_id and filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649966'. Join activities with compound_structures and molecule_dictionary on molregno to obtain canonical_smiles and chembl_id. Return one row per activity measurement.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_relation, a.standard_units FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649966' AND a.standard_relation = '='
